notes.title: Kept You Waiting Huh?
notes.content:
What's up squad! It's been a while since I last kept you up to date and I'm sorry about that. As many of you know I am the solo creator of Gym Empire, a passion project of the last 5 years. Behind the scenes I work on Gym Empire every day pushing to perfect my original vision of a fun, relaxed gym tycoon game.

But that's only half the job...

The other half is keeping up to date with you guys, the awesome crew that have been with me along the way. But in the last few months I've not done a very good job of that. Partly because I've been focused on some of the bigger updates coming in Gym Empire as we push towards the final release, but also down to the fact of some huge things happening in my personal life. All exciting and good, but very time consuming. It's a long story but it all started off with a possible move to Japan that never panned out. 

No excuses though and what felt like not posting for a couple of weeks has turned into months. But I'm back to let you know the final release is still coming and will be awesome!

Thank you for sticking with me so far and I promise to keep you more up to date again.

Chronik Spartan
Stav

notes.title: Fighting Club and Roid Rage Update
notes.content:
The latest update to Gym Empire bring in some huge functionality that add a whole new dynamic to the game!

To celebrate there will be a week long 20% Discount from 9th October!

[h2]Fighting Club[/h2]
Fighting Club is the first wave of Sports additions to Gym Empire. Bringing in the ability to add Boxing, Wrestling and MMA Equipment to your Gym. The update also includes a new Sports Need for Clients, which indicates what Sports the Client is interested in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652500/6c059099fcc276d40b3efb17e1e66c52bd5c8c94.png[/img]

Future Sports additions will include Football, Basketball, Swimming, Running and more. The Sports functionality also acts as the foundation for Celebrities, where Clients go on to become superstars in their chosen profession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652500/440eadb7f9df0b9b9ae7eebd30f1e58cc9a43887.png[/img]

[h2]Roid Rage[/h2]
Roid Rage brings in Roiders to Gym Empire. Oversized, loud and annoying Clients who bring down the mood of the Gym and cause damage to Equipment. Roiders will be attracted to Gyms that cater to their bulking needs so beware! You'll need to get rid of them quickly so they don't wreck your Gym and don't try to return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652500/f4aef2e161f6ff9e0ff51fb47748946bbcc686fd.png[/img]

Alongside the Roid Rage update, different Client types are now attracted to different Gym types based on the Gym Equipment available.

Image by vectorpouch on Freepik

notes.title: A Delayed Game Is Eventually Good
notes.content:
Shigeru Miyamoto said it best "A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad."

[b]Early Access Release[/b]
With that in mind we decided to push back the release of Gym Empire from March 27th 2023 to July 21st 2023 and pack Gym Empire with even more awesome content and customisation options ready for the Early Access release.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HJEHnqS.png[/img]

Gym Empire was already in a great state and fully ready for Early Access, but the more I saw people play the game the more I realised I wanted to put into it. The more I knew I could add in.

[b]Feature Packed[/b]
Making sure the first impression is the best it can be is really important. But what's even more important than that is rewarding the awesome community with a fully personalised experience. A tycoon game that really gives you that feeling of building your OWN Gym. Giving the players customisation options that truly let them design a unique Gym.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U8Yf65s.png[/img]

These features were always going to be added to Gym Empire during Early Access. But I felt now is the right time for these features. To reward the community for their awesome support, to push even harder to make sure Gym Empire players are treated to the best experience possible straight away.

I can't wait for you all to get stuck in!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nJlu9iI.png[/img]

notes.title: Gym Empire - Gym Tycoon Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
A few years ago this moment felt like a long distant dream. A light at the end tunnel that I couldn't yet see...

[h2]Five Years Later[/h2]
After five years of hard work, commitment and passion, with a huge amount of support from the community, the Gym Empire Early Access release date is finally coming. On 12th July 2023 Gym Empire will be available on Steam at a reduced price (about 70% the cost at Full Release) for Early Access adopters and a way to say thank you to all the great support so far.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OWsbPsm.gif[/img]

The road up until this point has taken many turns. With many changes going into the design and look of Gym Empire, most of which have come from great ideas in the community. One thing, however, has always remained clear in the road map for Gym Empire. Early Access will be a complete gameplay experience, providing a full slice of all the gameplay mechanics in the game. From this foundation, the next 6 months to a year of development will focus on fleshing out the existing mechanics by providing extra content and features.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmu6lxc.gif[/img]

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Gym Empire already focuses on a strong comedy element. With Clients suffering ridiculous accidents and radio DJ's Tom & Tom, AKA Biscuits and Gravy, providing a humorous background to the hard work and iron pumping of the Clients. Early Access development will plan to continue growing on the humour with Rival Gym, Celebrities and Monthly Awards. As well as expanding the variety and options for Gym development e.g. boxing rings, swimming pools and basketball courts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZbqMLA.gif[/img]

I'm so excited for you to all start your Gym Empire and I hope you are too!

Add Gym Empire to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/756300/Gym_Empire/]Steam Wishlist now[/url].

For more regular Gym Empire updates check out the [url=http://www.chronikspartan.com/]Chronik Spartan[/url] blog.

notes.title: Gym Empire Demo v0.4
notes.content:
Today is a big day. It's been a long road. Gym Empire is now available to play.

[h2]Playable Demo[/h2]
This Test/Demo build represents only 10% of the finished game and serves two purposes. Helping us the developer and rewarding you the awesome and dedicated community for your superb support so far.

[h2]Alpha Test[/h2]
The Alpha Test helps us to find as many bugs as possible. Especially those really annoying game breaking bugs. We've done our best to kill as many of those pesky bugs as possible. But due to our limited ability to do broad testing I know some of them will still be there. I apologise in advance for those annoying bugs that found there way through the cracks into this first build. But you are going to be the superheroes of this community that help us catch every one of those pesky bugs!

This is also an opportunity to highlight any features you would like to see, as there are many planned that are not present in the demo.

[h2]Demo[/h2]
The other purpose of this build is to finally let you, the amazing community, get a taste of Gym Empire. It's been a long time coming and you all have been so dedicated and patient.

Access to the demo is on itch.io which is provided through a simple link in our Discord server:

[url=https://discord.gg/XPU6x5R]Discord Link[/url]

So what are you waiting for? Let's start your Gym Empire...

notes.title: Gym Empire is NOT Dead!
notes.content:
So I came across a message from earlier in the year asking if Gym Empire is dead. This seemed odd to me as development is and has been going full speed since the start. But then it dawned on me... The lack of updates. Of course you wouldn't know it was still being developed if I'm not keeping you up to date.

Well although information has been pretty non existent here I've actually been updating the Discord and blog more regularly. It's just difficult to keep on track with updating all the various outlets. But that's my problem, I just need to sort it. 

In the meantime you can find out extra information in the Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/XPU6x5R

Just to get you up to speed. The updates dried up around the time I started the save system. It was a very boring development time with not a lot to describe. However since then tje UI has had a big overhaul and the tutorial system has been added in. Amongst many other features. We're actually really close to the first demo release and I can't wait to let you have your first taste of Gym Empire!

Chronik Spartan

notes.title: Exclusive Access to Gym Empire Beta Testing
notes.content:
The new and updated Chronik Spartan discord server has just launched!

https://discord.gg/XPU6x5R

Some might ask “What is a discord server?” It’s a place to chat and share ideas about similar interests. In this case Chronik Spartan Games, Gym Empire and all things game related.

All members gain exclusive access to beta testing for Gym Empire.

When you join the first thing you’ll want to do is pick your allegiance! Are you #WolfSpartan, #RavenSpartan or #PsychoSpartan?

You will then be able to compete in challenges to earn awesome rewards for your team! As well as ARGs, in depth coverage of game development, sharing of game features and loads of other cool stuff!

It’s going to be a fun and exciting place to be and I’d love to see my closest followers (you obviously!) over there!

Don’t forget to pick a team and get stuck in.

https://discord.gg/XPU6x5R

notes.title: Get A Character Named After You In Gym Empire!
notes.content:
Every little helps when it comes to running a solo development company. So after thinking for a while what I could possibly offer as rewards to all you Spartans out there, I decided to go ahead and create a Patreon account!

https://www.patreon.com/chronikspartan

I will be using any support on Patreon to go directly into Gym Empire development. Currently Gym Empire is at a stage where by the graphic and audio assets are being matured. To help make the progress on Gym Empire as quick as possible but still give it that polished finish I am now at the point of looking at funding development of these assets.

To give you something in return for your support I am offering a range of rewards from getting your name in the game credits to getting a character in Gym Empire named after you! As well as the opportunity for in depth development information and even the chance for one extravagant supporter to have an entire game with them as the main character! 

You can take a look at my Patreon account here:
https://www.patreon.com/chronikspartan

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
Hey everyone and thanks for taking a look at Gym Empire! 

Those of you who have added Gym Empire to your wishlist,  I appreciate it very much! Gym Empire is a game that is very important to me and I want it to be important to you too.

If you've added it at such an early stage then I trust you can see its potential. I want to work with you all to ensure this is a game we all love. 

There is a lot more work to be done to Gym Empire and it is going to be growing a lot over the next few months. One if the first things you might notice changing are going to be the look and style of the character. I want them to have a much more physical appearance and have a range of  body shapes. I'll be looking for opinions and feedback on this stage so if you're interested please keep an eye on this space or feel free to sign up to my mailing list on my blog www.chronikspartan.com.

If you want this game to be as great and successful as possible then you can genuinely help by providing feedback, telling people about Gym Empire and pointing them to this page so they can wishlist it.

Thank you again and welcome to the journey :)
Stavros Pilatis (Chronik Spartan)
